ほど.es: tanto como; hasta el punto de
ほど.en: as much as; to the point of

すぎます.consejo: It is combined with verbs and adjectives.

texto: To choose one of two things, put the chosen one with **の ほう が**: **バス の ほう が やすい です** (the bus is cheaper).
To compare with something else, use **より**, as you know: **でんしゃ より バス の ほう が やすい です** (the bus is cheaper than the train).
To say something **no es tan** as something else: **がっこう ほど とおく ない** (not as far away as school).
It is always used with denial.

bloques.titulo: The most important of these are:
texto: **いちばん** means «the more» or «the most». It goes in front of the adjective or verb: **すし が いちばん すき です** (I like sushi better).

It is added to the base in -h. in -h. h. without **ます**: **たべすぎます** (as too much); with an adjective in -i, remove **い**: **たかすぎます** (too expensive). With adjectives in -na **すぎます** is used after adjective: **しずかすぎます** (too quiet).

intro: Today you will learn to compare in other ways: to say which one you prefer, to say that something is not as much as something else, and to say what is the best.
